rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Music questions: link form to feeling — rhythm/melody create mood; state the mood first, then the musical cause.  ·  Trick 2: 'Music is universal' essays: one shared-emotion argument + one cultural-specificity argument, then synthesis.
